common.emergency: RehletShifaa is not an emergency medical service. If you are experiencing severe chest pain, severe shortness of breath, loss of consciousness, or another medical emergency, seek immediate emergency medical care in your current location.
common.medicalNotice: RehletShifaa coordinates access to medical review and care. Information provided through the platform does not replace emergency care or a complete clinical assessment. Final medical decisions are made by the treating consultant following appropriate evaluation.

home.title: Your Journey to Better Heart Care
home.intro: Send your medical reports and let RehletShifaa help direct your case to the appropriate cardiac consultant before you travel to Egypt.
home.reassurance: Not sure which cardiac specialty you need? You don't have to be.
home.areasTitle: Specialist pathways, guided by your case

areas.title: Coronary Arteries & Cardiac Catheterization
areas.body: For patients requiring evaluation for coronary angiography, PCI, stents or complex coronary intervention.

areas.title: Heart Valves & Structural Heart
areas.body: Advanced assessment and catheter-based valve interventions including TAVI/TAVR and selected mitral and tricuspid interventions.

areas.title: Heart Rhythm & Cardiac Devices
areas.body: Assessment for Pacemaker, ICD, CRT-P and CRT-D when medically appropriate.

home.coordinatorBody: Your Patient Coordinator stays connected with you from your first contact through treatment coordination and follow-up.
home.beforeTitle: Understand Your Care Path Before You Travel
home.beforeBody: Where medically possible, RehletShifaa helps you understand the proposed next steps and expected arrangements before deciding to travel.
home.finalBody: You don't need to know the name of the specialty or procedure. Send what you have. We'll help with the next step.

cardiology.title: Advanced Cardiac Care, Guided by Your Case
cardiology.intro: You don't need to choose a cardiac specialty yourself. Send your medical information and RehletShifaa will help direct your case to the appropriate consultant.
coronaryItems: Evaluation for alternative treatment when PCI is not appropriate
coronaryExamples: Coronary artery narrowing or blockage was diagnosed
Coronary disease was described as complex
Another opinion is required before intervention
cardiology.suitability: Suitability for any procedure is determined only after consultant review.
rhythmExamples: A second opinion is needed before device implantation
cardiology.finalTitle: Not Sure Where Your Condition Fits?
cardiology.finalBody: That's completely fine. You do not need to select a specialty. Send your reports and we'll help direct your case to the appropriate consultant.

consultants.title: Experienced Cardiac Consultants
consultants.intro: Your case is directed to the consultant whose area of expertise is most appropriate for the medical information provided.
consultants.notice: Development profiles — names and credentials below are clearly marked placeholders and must be replaced with verified consultant data before publication.
consultants.finalTitle: You Don't Need to Choose a Consultant
consultants.finalBody: Not sure which consultant is right for your condition? Send your case and RehletShifaa will help direct it to the appropriate consultant.

how.title: Your Care Journey, Clearly Coordinated
how.intro: From your first medical reports to treatment coordination, RehletShifaa helps make the process simpler.

steps.title: Send Your Case
steps.body: Send the medical reports and investigations already available.

steps.title: Patient Coordinator
steps.body: Your dedicated coordinator organizes your information and helps identify missing documents.

steps.title: Consultant Review
steps.body: Your case is directed to the appropriate cardiac consultant.

steps.title: Understand Your Care Path
steps.body: Recommendations may include further investigation, medical treatment, catheterization, coronary or valve intervention, cardiac devices, surgical evaluation, or another appropriate pathway.

steps.title: Treatment Coordination
steps.body: If you decide to proceed in Egypt, RehletShifaa coordinates the required next steps.

steps.title: Treatment & Follow-Up
steps.body: Coordination continues through treatment and follow-up according to consultant recommendations.

form.title: Send Your Medical Case
form.intro: You don't need to know which cardiac specialty you need. Send what you already have and we'll help guide the next step.
form.name: Full Name
form.description: Tell Us Briefly About Your Condition
form.uploadHelp: Don't have all your reports? That's okay. Send what you have and your Patient Coordinator will help with the rest.
